articles.title: Guidance Note – General business insurers with segregated accounts and separate accounts
articles.summary: Bermuda's new BMA guidance, effective January 1, 2027, requires each cell to meet its own solvency, liquidity and collateral tests, adding governance and reporting duties for Canadian parents using Bermuda cell captives.

articles.title: Premier says Cayman focused on securing US reinsurance recognition
articles.summary: Cayman's Premier says the government is backing its NAIC Qualified Jurisdiction application, with property and casualty reviewed first; any resulting rule changes will involve consultation with the captive industry.

articles.title: VCIA to Host Captive Tax Update Webinar December 10
articles.summary: Vermont's captive association will review IRS regulations, global minimum tax rules and state premium taxes on December 10, a useful briefing for Canadian groups with Vermont captives planning for 2027.

articles.title: Why some Canadian companies are bringing captive risks home to Alberta
articles.summary: Hub International says Canadian firms are redomiciling captive risks from offshore to Alberta, citing flexible rules now allowing surety, lower premiums, and better tax outcomes than offshore captives taxed under FAPI.

articles.title: Piko Re targeting untapped captive reinsurance market
articles.summary: New captive-focused reinsurance intermediary Piko Re will target mid-sized single-parent captives and segregated cells, starting in the US with Canada flagged as a potential early expansion market.

articles.title: Captive owners find new ways to finance risks, manage losses
articles.summary: Vermont's captive regulator reports owners converting single-parent captives into sponsored captives to insure partner and joint-venture risks in segregated cells, a structure Canadian parents with Vermont captives may consider.
